description: This file defines the NotesAdapter class for rendering a list of notes in a RecyclerView, including handling click events and binding note data to views.

classes.name: NotesAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of Note objects with click handling.

classes.name: NotesAdapter.NoteViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder class that binds Note data to UI components within each list item.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with a new list of notes and refreshes the view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a new ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Note object to the ViewHolder and sets up click listener.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of notes in the list.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds Note properties to UI components within the ViewHolder.
